verdict.rationale: Deel can be driven without its UI through its own REST API, using API-token authentication (non-interactive) as well as OAuth2. It also offers an isolated API Sandbox with resettable data, which suits automated testing. That is a true sandbox environment, not a dry-run mode. Nothing documents a CLI, CI-pipeline integration, or headless usage guidance specifically. missing for 10: official CLI or CI integration docs (e.g. GitHub Actions examples), explicit guidance on headless or service-account usage, independent hands-on corroboration of CI automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: # Create a contractor contract POST https://api.letsdeel.com/rest/contracts
Deel supports two authentication methods: ... API tokens ... OAuth2
The Deel API Sandbox is a **completely isolated testing environment** that mirrors production functionality without affecting real data, triggering actual payments, or creating legal contracts.
Resetting will delete all test data you've created and restore the original pre-populated sample data.
